title: A month whose pricing location is not ready
assertion: With no ZIP, no run is created (refused in the worker and in Postgres). When a line needs a ZIP+4, or a ZIP Medicare's list does not hold, the run fails with no lines kept, and the month is not re-created daily. A fixed-fee month prices. Coverage and Pricing settings name the month as waiting on the billing ZIP, with its dollars. Saving the location prices it with no hand re-run
noFileReason: Practices and their locations are set by the tests; the 835 is the monitoring fixture.
